::: {.timeline-content}
**EEG-Based Alzheimer’s Disease Detection**   
*PhD Research Project · FAU*

- Conducted research under the supervision of my advisor, developing deep learning and graph neural network models for Alzheimer’s disease detection using multi-channel EEG signals.
- Extracted and analyzed spectral and connectivity-based features (e.g., PSD, relative band power, coherence) and explored graph-based representations for classification, evaluating performance at both segment and subject levels.
- Designed and trained models using PyTorch, focusing on efficient training and scalable experimentation.
:::
:::

*Software Engineering Course Project · FAU*

Collaborated closely with front-end and back-end teams to embed AI features into the web application, providing technical feedback and support to ensure accuracy, security, and usability across the system.

::: {.timeline-content}
**Stock Portfolio Optimization using Deep Learning**   
*Master Thesis*

- Developed a deep learning framework for **portfolio optimization** using historical data from 50 Vietnamese stocks (2016–2021).
- Constructed **3D financial tensors** integrating price data, trading volume, and technical indicators including exponential moving averages (EMA).
- Designed and trained a **BiGRU model with self-attention** implemented in Keras (TensorFlow), achieving improved predictive performance and portfolio stability compared to baseline investment strategies.
